svg.title: System Canvas application architecture
svg.desc: Vite builds the TypeScript and React frontend; the browser runs a repository-owned SVG editor module, keeps a JSON copy in localStorage, and synchronizes board documents through a Node.js and Fastify application server to filesystem snapshots.
